headline: Lindsey Graham RIP: Trump Calls Him Senate GIANT 🍆
text:

Now the Senate lost its "VIM AND VIGOUR" 💪🔥 and Darline's taking the REINS 🐎 while the world mourns the hawk who "LEFT US MUCH TOO SOON" ⏰💔!
